MEMORANDUM

To:All Marketing Department Staff
From:Douglas Ferreira, Vice President of Marketing
Date:November 6
Subject:Nine-Month Review
Attachment:Graph

I would like to congratulate everyone on the strong showing of Harborlight Audiobooks over the past nine months. As the attached graph shows, we have already signed up two million new subscriptions. Our results have been particularly good through the mobile app, largely because we rebuilt the listening screen in the spring.

Growth through our partner bookshops, however, has been slower than we hoped. I have therefore asked Yuki Tanabe to lead a promotional campaign that will, I hope, drive our numbers in that channel.

From next month she will be working with independent booksellers’ associations to raise awareness of the service. Our aim is to double subscriptions through that channel by the end of the year.

Thank you all for your continued hard work.
